title: Length-at-age growth of flying fishes (Exocoetidae): FishBase von Bertalanffy rows plus otolith and early-life data
not_a_mechanistic_model: Growth is data-driven: published von Bertalanffy fits, L(t) = Linf (1 - exp(-K (t - t0))), and point measurements. Nothing here simulates development.
conditions: Field growth fits already embed the average conditions of their locality (food, temperature). Per conditions/baseline.json nothing is adjusted for temperature or nutrition; water temperatures below are metadata only (FishBase Temp column).

coverage.note: Of 75 Exocoetidae species on FishBase, 7 have growth rows (12 rows); all 12 show their reference on FishBase. No Exocoetus growth row exists.

fishbase_rows.fishbase_comment: Samples collected in Jun -Oct, 2013 during spawning, comprised only of dead spawners entangled in FADs. Presumably no juveniles, thus growth refers to adults (total sample size range: 20.0-27.4 cm FL, Table 1 in Ref. 116840 ).

default_curve.equation: FL_cm(t_yr) = 23.3 * (1 - exp(-3.12 * (t_yr - 0.01)))  (t = age since hatching, years)

Linf.locator: autoctr 4651 (Main Ref 6829 = Oxenford et al. 1994, Mar Biol 118:585)

why_this_row: the only row FishBase marks as validated: "Validated by lab. rearing of larvae and mark-recapture of adults"; based on otolith daily increments (paper title)
check 1: Campana et al. 1993: the otolith core "would correspond to a fish of about 12 cm in length and an age of 80 d"; this curve gives 11.2 cm FL at 80 d
check 2: FishBase maturity row tm = 0.63 yr (Eastern Caribbean, Ref 6838); this curve gives 19.9 cm FL at 0.63 yr; Oxenford et al. 1995: H. affinis "reaches sexual maturity at about 190 mm"
check 3: Campana et al. 1993: "the mean age of adult flyingfish was about 1 yr, and significantly less than 2 yr"
caveats: FishBase flags this row Questionable = Yes and auximetric outlier = Yes, and says "Do not use M value for new model to predict M"
we have not read Oxenford et al. 1994; only its Crossref metadata and the FishBase transcription
below about 2 cm the fit is not meaningful (L = 0 at t0 = 3.7 d); trajectory.mjs replaces it there with an assumed linear segment from an assumed hatch length
alternatives: H. affinis, Tobago: Linf 30.5 cm TL, K 1.695, t0 -0.05 (not flagged questionable)
Cheilopogon and Cypselurus rows from the Camotes Sea, Philippines (Dalzell 1993; Lavapie-Gonzales et al. 1997)
